CA.rationale: Content coordinates and an explicit processing/origin tag (command_estimate) are bound for the same candidate entry.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates), an organization/presentation cue (positions), and a distinct status/provenance (origin) are all present and bound to the same current entry.

A.rationale: Origin/processing tags explicitly link content entries to processing/transfer conditions (command_estimate, inherited_current), tying allocation/change to the same content entries.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored cell sets (red/blue) with coordinates.

D.rationale: Origins and execution flags separately attribute provenance/status to content entries, distinguishing identification from status/presentation provenance.

O.rationale: Entries include how content is represented and currently accessible (coordinate positions and origin/provenance), describing presentation/organization/access.
